description: Project tasks, listed in F6 beside the ones Lightdown finds.

tasks.description: The tasks, each with a unique name.

argv.description: The program and its arguments, run without a shell. Give this or shell.

shell.description: A command line run with sh -c. Give this or argv.

cwd.description: The folder to run in, from the project root. It must exist.

propertyNames.patternMessage: is not a valid environment variable name

dependsOn.description: Tasks to run first, in order; a background task counts once it is ready.

problemMatcher.description: A regular expression with named groups file and line, and optionally column, severity and message, for errors in the output.

items.patternMessage: must be a relative glob that stays in the project

watch.description: Globs; saving a matching file runs the task again.

readyPattern.description: A regular expression; the task counts as ready when a line of its output matches.

background.description: For servers and watchers: the task keeps running, and tasks that depend on it start once it is ready.
